rule: Take the derivative of each lifted stage log(E_r(z))=r*z. Multiply its modulus over the m=320 occurrences of one arrow. Compare each flank with the midpoint by d=m*log(|x+i*y|/y). Positive H=2*pi*abs(k)/d, winding k from the coherent full scalar-return derivative log. Four flank addresses collapse by symmetry. Chosen external Mellin scale Z=ratio of these marked products (power c=1).

grid.exact: pi*n, nearest lattice point to the Dottie height

budget.predictor: one degree-48 continued dyadic cosine/Riemann-Siegel phase polynomial per arm; find all complex polynomial roots in the open window; no zeta evaluations
budget.certificate: two mirrored-height-offset charts per arm (centers H +/- 1/8), 144 complex ball samples per chart at 192 bits; contour-depth cap 23, 64 Hardy sign cells per chart with up to 19 bisections. Unresolved remains unresolved.
budget.tests: both full rectangles and both signed-half slabs; every positive forecast gets its own disjoint-from-line box; preselect closest adjacent negative predicted pair per arm if present, padded 1/100 at each end, clipped to window. Check its wide count and line brackets.
budget.positive_replication: Any strictly off-line positive candidate count requires a second rigorous evaluation independent of the original interpolant before claiming a discovery; retain all four reflected/conjugate boxes and report any unresolved duplication.
budget.primary_outcome: number of certified off-line hit windows per arm (one each). Secondary: forecast vs actual broad counts; closer line gaps and simple line-zero counts do not count as off-line hits.
